description: This file contains service management functions for Virtual Access Points (VAPs) in a Wi-Fi driver or management layer. It initializes VAP services, updates global caches, manages ACL entries, retrieves capability info, and handles start/stop operations for different VAP types and interfaces.

methods.name: int svc_init(vap_svc_t * svc,vap_svc_type_t type)
methods.description: Initializes a VAP service structure based on the specified type, assigning function pointers for start, stop, update, event handling, and identity checks.

methods.name: int update_global_cache(wifi_vap_info_map_t * tgt_vap_map,rdk_wifi_vap_info_t * rdk_vap_info)
methods.description: Updates the global cache of VAP information with new data, ensuring consistency across internal data structures.

methods.name: int update_acl_entries(wifi_vap_info_map_t * tgt_vap_map)
methods.description: Updates Access Control List (ACL) entries for the specified VAP map, calling underlying HAL or driver functions to add MAC addresses.

methods.name: wifi_interface_name_idex_map_t * get_wifi_hal_capability_info(wifi_platform_property_t * wifi_prop,wifi_vap_info_t * old_vap_info)
methods.description: Retrieves capability info related to Wi-Fi interfaces by matching VAP names to interface map entries.

methods.name: int update_vap_hal_prop_bridge_name(vap_svc_t * svc,wifi_vap_info_map_t * vap_map)
methods.description: Updates the bridge name property for VAPs, based on their current configuration and mesh status.

methods.name: int vap_svc_start_stop(vap_svc_t * svc,unsigned int radio_index,bool enable)
methods.description: Starts or stops VAP services for given radios, creating or destroying VAPs as needed.

methods.name: int vap_svc_stop(vap_svc_t * svc,unsigned int radio_index)
methods.description: Stops VAP services on a specified radio by invoking start_stop with enable=false.

methods.name: int vap_svc_start(vap_svc_t * svc,unsigned int radio_index)
methods.description: Starts VAP services on a specified radio by invoking start_stop with enable=true.

methods.name: vap_svc_t * get_svc_by_type(wifi_ctrl_t * ct,vap_svc_type_t type)
methods.description: Retrieves a VAP service instance from the control structure based on its type.

methods.name: vap_svc_t * get_svc_by_name(wifi_ctrl_t * ct,char * vap_name)
methods.description: Determines the service type based on VAP name substrings and retrieves the corresponding service.

methods.name: vap_svc_t * get_svc_by_vap_index(wifi_ctrl_t * ct,unsigned int vap_index)
methods.description: Finds the VAP service instance that manages a specific VAP by its index.

ctags.name: vap_svc_start_stop
ctags.pattern: /^int vap_svc_start_stop(vap_svc_t *svc, unsigned int radio_index, bool enable)$/
